status_semantics.IN_PROGRESS: Verified work/evidence exists but final acceptance not reached.
status_semantics.BACKGROUND_IN_PROGRESS: Independently supervised evidence generation is active; MAIN should not poll it.
status_semantics.NOT_YET_VERIFIED: Do not assume complete or incomplete; final acceptance is not yet verified from current evidence.

gaps.criterion: Splits and leakage controls are frozen.
gaps.reason: Published bidding D3 split/calendar-role impact remains an explicit unresolved integrity blocker.
Do not infer final acceptance from historical milestones; re-use existing provenance when this becomes consequential.

gaps.criterion: B1 learned bidding has received a real gameplay acceptance decision.
gaps.reason: Frozen R9 external evaluation is independently supervised and has not yet reached its preregistered decision boundary.
Engineering/self-play evidence does not by itself establish final accepted autonomous RL capability.

gaps.criterion: Belief/search/other treatments can be tested causally.
gaps.reason: Research candidates exist, but final causal-treatment capability is not assumed accepted.
No final-acceptance claim is made without direct evidence.
Frozen R9 and staged multi-table/runtime work generate evidence; final production-valid acceptance remains separate.

gaps.criterion: Kermit, Zoot, theCount and other opponents are external benchmarks.
gaps.reason: External ISS evaluation exists; final diverse-opposition acceptance remains to be concluded.

gaps.criterion: ISS failures feed a controlled weakness-mining loop.
gaps.reason: Do not infer an accepted closed loop from isolated diagnostics.
Final unattended end-to-end automation has not been accepted.
Multiple recovery paths exist, but final whole-system acceptance is separate.
2026-09-25 MAIN cost incident proved previous model-cost governance inadequate; replacement controller is being validated while MAIN is hard-disabled.

gaps.criterion: One stable SkatAI deployment interface exists.
gaps.reason: Host/interface work exists but final stable integration acceptance is not assumed.

gaps.criterion: Accepted SkatAI is integrated into the user's Skat software.
gaps.reason: JSkat/product work is staged/researched, not final accepted integration.

gaps.criterion: Release artifacts are reproducible and versioned.
gaps.reason: Release evidence exists, but end-state release acceptance is not assumed.
Not currently on the shortest consequential path; verify only when needed.
Final acceptance gate has not been established as passed.
MAIN is intentionally hard-disabled until cost/goal/evidence governance is fully verified.

gaps.criterion: The system can keep generating and testing stronger challengers without routine human work.
gaps.reason: This is the final steady-state outcome and must not be inferred from individual autonomous components.

selection_rule: MAIN must select one unresolved gap whose dependency prerequisites are currently executable and whose closure gives the greatest verified progress on the shortest valid path to the defining success condition. Background jobs do not become PRIMARY merely because they are running.
